title: Does the Jira status count when the design is posted to Teams or Slack?
context: When the ticket is in Jira but the design is posted to Microsoft Teams or Slack, should moving the Jira ticket to the approved status also count as sign-off? Sign-off could then come from two places, and the team needs to know which one starts the build.
